§ 00About

India’s Trade Intelligence Company.

Established in 2018, XIMPEX has spent eight years building a system that delivers trade results — for manufacturers, agrarian businesses, and merchant exporters across India, with a special focus on first-time exporters.

  • →8+ years in Indian export services
  • →100+ consulting engagements
  • →1M+ trade data points
  • →India-based, India-focused
§ 01
Industry Focus · Why us

Multidisciplinary, long-term, on your side.

The XIMPEX team

Exporting from India is rarely failed by the product. It’s failed by the gap between knowing your factory and knowing the international market. That gap is what XIMPEX was built to close.

Our team works across the four disciplines that gap demands — trade intelligence, lead generation, compliance and documentation, and logistics co-ordination. No piece outsourced to a third party that doesn’t own the outcome. One desk, one team, one accountable owner for your deal — start to shipment.

We work with first-time exporters and established merchants the same way: data-led on the inputs, hands-on through the close. Long enough in this market to know which buyer enquiry will convert and which won’t — and honest enough to tell you before you spend on the wrong one.

Let’s embark

On your Global Journey.

If you’re ready to take your business to new heights, we invite you to partner with us. Let us show you how our expertise, personalised approach, and unwavering commitment can make a real difference to your export endeavors.

Contact us today for a free consultation and discover the world of opportunities that awaits you in the global marketplace.

Mission & Vision

What we're here to do — and where we're going.

§ 05
What we believe

Six principles the product is built on.

01

Free where it should be free.

The guides and the India-aggregate trade data cost nothing and never will. Knowing how to export, and where a product sells, should not sit behind a paywall.

02

Real, or not at all.

Every number is sourced; every buyer is present and verified. When we don't know, we say so — the platform never invents data to look complete.

03

Each step earns the next.

An export is a sequence, not a dashboard. We walk it in order — profile, market, buyer, deal, shipment — and each stage has to be real before the next begins.

04

The human owns the deal.

AI does the heavy lifting — research, drafting, qualifying, translating — but the exporter on the factory floor makes the calls. We assist; we don't pretend to be the trader.

05

Plain language, always.

Trade is full of jargon that keeps first-time exporters out. We write everything so a newcomer and a seasoned merchant both read it the same way.

06

One place, end to end.

From the first HS code to the bill of lading — one considered workspace, not a dozen tabs, spreadsheets and lost email threads.

§ 06
Why XIMPEX

Eight reasons — examined, one at a time.

How we work

Eight principles compiled across eight years of Indian export-services work. Each is a working method — not a marketing word. Scroll through to see each one in detail.

↓ Scroll to read
01

Comprehensive

A holistic approach that covers you from all corners.

Expert management gains the respect and trust of clients, which makes it simpler to win their support for new initiatives. We bring competence across every phase of the export journey.

02

Financially Smart

Specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, time-bound.

Whether seeking quick wins or building long-term roadmaps, we use simple tools to minimise your cost and optimise our resources to provide the most efficient output.

03

A Great Team

A collaborative brain pool aligned with our clients' success.

At XIMPEX, we provide a creative environment for our talented team. Freshers from top institutes hone their skills in foreign trade, web development, digital marketing and more.

04

Sequentially Interdependent

Each step earns the right to begin the next.

We have structured our process so that the successful completion of each step is almost mandatory for the next to begin. These checkpoints ensure that we do our best and monitor productivity internally.

05

Result Oriented

Tangible deliverables at every stage.

From BANT-qualified leads, to a carefully crafted website built around visitor engagement, to a global presence of representatives — we design our system to deliver outcomes, not activity.

06

Customised Solutions

A different proposition for every client.

Whether you want us to manage your digital presence or your entire export operation, XIMPEX has something for you. Mini-packages let you test the quality of leads or our marketing before committing.

07

Secure & Safe

Your trade is a guarded undertaking.

Whether securing payments via L/C or DP, or verifying buyers through the Chamber of Commerce, we minimise your trade risk and keep you informed of best practices in international trade.

08

Technically Superior

AI-augmented intelligence, not AI hype.

Our platform combines 1M+ trade data points with AI to give you decisions, not dashboards. AISHA — our WhatsApp-native AI agent — qualifies leads, drafts compliance, and answers HS-code questions, while a human team owns the deal.
